approach: Static recompilation of the EE code with PS2Recomp, and a native Metal renderer fed at the game's own draw calls (models, skinning, lighting, fog, bloom, 2D)
notes: Runs on macOS through static recompilation. The PS2 hardware is being replaced step by step: the native renderer (SOTC_NATIVE=1) draws the game from its own model, texture and sprite data with Metal, without the VIF/VU1/GS path. PS Vita is the long-term target.
